cases.title: Cold launch, tab overview, and start page rendering
preconditions: Connected unlocked HarmonyOS device; signed entry HAP installed
steps: Launch com.youdroid.browser via aa start
Open TabOverview and tap + 新建标签页
Inspect StartPage wallpaper, quick sites, settings gear, and browser dock
assertions: App launches cleanly into foreground without blank startup glitches
StartPage displays 每日美图 wallpaper, quick-site grid (下载页, 知乎, 哔哩哔哩, 少数派, 微博, 豆瓣, 36氪, 添加), top-right gear button, dock address pill, tab count badge, and menu button
failureSignals: Blank startup screen, missing wallpaper or dock controls, startup crash

cases.title: Start page quick-site editor, page settings, and background picker
steps: Tap 添加 quick-site tile to open QuickSiteEditor and tap 取消
Tap StartPage top-right gear to open PageSettingsPanel and dismiss
Long-press StartPage background to open HomeBackgroundPicker and dismiss
assertions: QuickSiteEditor renders 自定义/书签/历史 tabs and inputs cleanly above IME
PageSettingsPanel shows quick sites count/toggle, background toggle, theme, and 更多设置
HomeBackgroundPicker renders 每日美图, presets (雾山, 巷影), and gallery option
failureSignals: Unresponsive editor/sheets, keyboard overlap clipping actions, crash

cases.title: Omnibox input and IME Go key submission for Google search
steps: Tap browser-address dock pill to open AddressSheet
Enter 'g harmonyos' into address-input
Tap Sogou IME 「开始」 (EnterKeyType.Go) button
assertions: IME Go key immediately submits query without needing toolbar suggestions
Google Search navigates to https://www.google.com/search?q=harmonyos and renders full SERP (AI 概览 and organic results) with no '更新浏览器' / unsupported-browser banner
failureSignals: IME Go key unresponsive, '更新浏览器' block page, failed submission

cases.title: Compatible mobile User-Agent stability across Google and non-Google sites
preconditions: Loaded Google SERP and sspai.com in browser session
steps: Load Google SERP under uniform compatible Android Chrome mobile UA
Navigate to https://sspai.com and verify desktop/mobile rendering
assertions: Google search and sspai.com both render cleanly with no unsupported browser errors
No runtime per-host UA switching occurs during navigation interception
failureSignals: Google unsupported-browser wall, broken layout on CN sites

cases.title: Cross-site Back, Forward, Reload, and Long-press address menu
preconditions: Tab navigated from Google SERP to https://sspai.com
steps: Tap dock Back (browser-dock-back) from sspai.com to return to Google SERP
Tap dock Forward (browser-dock-forward) back to sspai.com
Tap dock Reload and long-press browser-address pill
assertions: Cross-site Back returns smoothly to Google SERP with zero ArkWeb abort/reload loop and zero ThreadBlock6S freeze
Forward returns to sspai.com and Reload completes cleanly
Long-press opens address context menu (访问复制的链接/粘贴, 复制链接, 关闭当前标签)
failureSignals: THREAD_BLOCK_3S/6S process kill, infinite reload loop, unresponsive Back/Forward

cases.title: Network error state panel and retry flow
steps: Navigate to https://nonexistent.invalid
Inspect rendered ErrorStatePanel and tap 重试
assertions: ErrorStatePanel renders 没有网络连接 prompt and 重试 action without crashing
Tapping 重试 initiates reload attempt cleanly
failureSignals: Permanent blank white screen on DNS/network error, unresponsive Retry button

cases.title: Normal tabs, private tabs creation, preview redaction, and closing
preconditions: Browser active with existing user tabs preserved
steps: Inspect live preview thumbnail in TabOverview for active sspai.com tab
Open ActionSheet and tap 新建无痕标签页
Verify dock privacy indicator, open TabOverview to check 无痕 section, and close temporary private tab
assertions: Dock address pill shows 无痕 badge in private mode
TabOverview separates private tabs under 无痕 section without thumbnail leakage
Closing QA tabs leaves pre-existing user tabs (tab-1, tab-17, tab-18, tab-19) intact
failureSignals: Private preview leaks screenshot, missing private badge, user tabs accidentally closed

cases.title: Dock horizontal swipe tab switch and RecentTabs sheet
steps: Swipe horizontally across browser-address pill
Open ActionSheet and tap 最近标签页 (RecentTabsDock)
Select a recent tab card (sspai.com)
assertions: Horizontal swipe switches smoothly to adjacent tab and updates indicator dots
RecentTabsDock lists recently visited tabs with active indicator and switches selection cleanly
failureSignals: Deadlock on hibernated/blank WebView during tab switch, unresponsive swipe

cases.title: ActionSheet multi-page navigation and dismissal
steps: Tap dock ≡ menu button to open ActionSheet page 1
Swipe horizontally to page 2 and scroll QuickActions row
Dismiss via scrim tap or back navigation
assertions: Page 1, Page 2 (查找, 阅读模式, 分享), QuickActions row (保存文章, 加入书签, 历史记录, 下载任务, 文章库, 设置), and BlockingRow render clearly
Swiping and dismissing animate cleanly
failureSignals: Missing actions, clipped pager, stuck backdrop

cases.title: Find-in-page search, match navigation, and clear on close
steps: Open ActionSheet page 2 and tap 查找
Enter '少数派' in find-query-input
Tap Next (>) and Previous (<) buttons, then tap Close (✕)
assertions: Match counter updates from 0/0 to 1/7 and increments to 2/7 on Next
Page scrolls to highlighted match and FindSheet closes cleanly on ✕
failureSignals: Counter stuck at 0/0, buttons unresponsive, highlights remain after close

cases.title: UserAgentPolicySheet bottom alignment, Desktop mode toggle, and Mobile restore
steps: Open ActionSheet and tap 桌面版 to open UserAgentPolicySheet
Verify header '网站显示策略' sits unclipped inside bottom sheet with scrim
Toggle 桌面版 (once) and reload, then restore 手机版 and test scrim dismiss
assertions: UserAgentPolicySheet anchors to bottom with handle and scrim, with header completely below status bar
Switching between 桌面版 and 手机版 reloads cleanly without stuck loading
failureSignals: Header clipped under status bar, missing scrim, crash on UA reload

cases.title: Web dark mode setting and page visual adaptation
steps: Open ActionSheet and tap 网页深色模式 to open WebDarkMode picker in Settings
Select 常暗 and return to active web page
Verify dark page rendering, then restore 跟随系统
assertions: sspai.com switches to dark palette under 常暗 while browser chrome adapts cleanly
Restoring 跟随系统 reverts web dark mode without side effects
failureSignals: No visual dark-mode effect, illegible contrast, setting fails to restore

cases.title: Connection security inspection and per-site control policies
steps: Tap dock shield icon inside browser-address pill to open SecurityPanel
Dismiss SecurityPanel and open BlockPanel -> 本站网页控制 (SiteControlSheet)
assertions: SecurityPanel confirms HTTPS encryption and host sspai.com
SiteControlSheet lists per-site overrides (网络拦截, 跟踪器, 外观清理, 自动阅读模式, 深色网页, 桌面版 UA)
failureSignals: Unresponsive shield button, missing host info, crashed site controls page

cases.title: Ad/tracker blocking stats, activity log, and site toggle
preconditions: Loaded sspai.com page with blocked requests counter > 0
steps: Tap dock blocked-request badge / ActionSheet blocking row to open BlockPanel
Open 本页拦截活动 (BlockEventSheet) and return to BlockPanel
Toggle 在此站点关闭拦截 off and back on
assertions: BlockPanel shows per-site (28 -> 40) and cumulative (1,563 -> 1,575) blocked tracker counts
BlockEventSheet opens cleanly and site protection toggle restores cleanly
failureSignals: Broken stats display, toggle state lost, crash on returning from events list

cases.title: Reader Mode extraction and ReaderBar typography/theme controls
steps: Open ActionSheet page 2 and tap 阅读模式
Tap A+, dark paper theme circle, A-, sepia circle on ReaderBar
Tap 完成 to exit Reader Mode
assertions: Reader Mode extracts article title and clean body paragraphs without site clutter
ReaderBar adjusts font size and paper palette immediately and 完成 exits back to web page
failureSignals: Empty extraction on article page, ReaderBar buttons unresponsive

cases.title: Article library gating and OfflineArticleReader inspection
preconditions: Article Library contains pre-existing saved 36kr article on Free tier
steps: Trigger 保存文章 and open 文章库 (ArticleLibrarySheet) from ActionSheet QuickActions
Inspect existing saved article entry and tap it to open OfflineArticleReader
Verify offline article text and highlights, then return cleanly without altering user article
assertions: ArticleLibrarySheet renders search, filters, Free-tier pro notice, and existing 36kr article
OfflineArticleReader displays offline body text, bold sections, highlights, 划线, and 笔记与整理 controls
failureSignals: Article fails to render offline, crash in library or reader

cases.title: Bookmark creation, search filter, and removal
steps: Open ActionSheet and tap 加入书签
Open 编辑书签 (FavoritesSheet) and search '退烧'
Exit FavoritesSheet, reopen ActionSheet and tap 移出书签 to clean up temporary QA bookmark
assertions: Bookmark appears immediately in FavoritesSheet with title, host, and timestamp alongside user bookmark
Search filters to matching entry, and 移出书签 cleanly removes QA bookmark (reverts label to 加入书签)
failureSignals: Duplicate bookmark, broken search filter, failure to remove QA bookmark

cases.title: History list recording and search filter
steps: Open ActionSheet and tap 历史记录 (HistorySheet)
Verify recorded visits and enter 'harmonyos' in search bar
assertions: HistorySheet displays chronological entries (bai.xo, sspai.com, harmonyos - Google 搜索) with delete actions
Search filters cleanly to matching google.com history item
failureSignals: Missing session history entries, search returns empty or crashes

cases.title: Downloads sheet UI and empty-state rendering
steps: Open ActionSheet and tap 下载任务 (DownloadSheet)
Verify sheet renders cleanly and exit back
assertions: DownloadSheet displays '下载任务' header, empty state ('暂无下载任务'), and back navigation works
failureSignals: Blank sheet or crash opening Downloads

cases.title: Share panel options rendering on loaded page
steps: Open ActionSheet page 2 and tap 分享
Inspect SharePanel actions and dismiss
assertions: SharePanel shows page title, sspai.com host, 系统分享, 分享截图, 复制链接, and 加入稍后读
failureSignals: Missing metadata, broken action icons, stuck modal

cases.title: JavaScript alert/confirm/prompt dialog handling
preconditions: Test page invoking JS alert/confirm/prompt dialogs
steps: Trigger JS dialog from loaded page and verify JsPromptSheet interaction
assertions: Alert/confirm/prompt sheet displays origin/message and resolves JsResult cleanly
failureSignals: Hanging JS dialog callback locking renderer

cases.title: Settings page search, pickers, privacy toggles, and feedback modal
steps: Open SettingsPage via ActionSheet and open 默认搜索引擎 picker (verify 必应/百度/谷歌/DuckDuckGo)
Scroll lower sections (appearance, tab limits, privacy/site permissions, about v1.0.3)
Tap 用户反馈 to open FeedbackSheet without submitting, dismiss, then test settings-search-input with '外观'
assertions: Pickers, toggles, version info (1.0.3), ICP filing row, FeedbackSheet, and live settings search ('匹配的设置 -> 外观') all work cleanly
failureSignals: Search fails to filter, picker stuck, crash opening feedback

cases.title: Real Pro IAP purchase and restore checkout
preconditions: Huawei IAP test account and manual checkout confirmation
steps: Trigger real Huawei IAP purchase flow
assertions: Excluded from automated QA to prevent unapproved real financial transaction
failureSignals: Unexpected charge

cases.title: Destructive close-all-tabs and clear-all-browsing-data
steps: Execute 全部关闭 / 清除浏览数据
assertions: Excluded on device to preserve user's existing tabs, history, cookies, and bookmarks
failureSignals: User session data loss
